cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.description: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.description: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

cards.name: Single Strike Urshifu
cards.description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: It was built 20 years ago by scientists who dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have yet to come true.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: Even though it doesn't die in the vacuum of space, it can't move around very well in zero gravity.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.description: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Castform
cards.description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.description: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.description: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.description: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

cards.name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Skies
Grookey
cards.description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.description: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.description: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Castform Sunny Form
cards.description: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

cards.name: Castform Rainy Form
cards.description: This is Castform's form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn't change to this form.

cards.name: Castform Snowy Form
cards.description: This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.description: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.description: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.description: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

cards.name: Drizzile
cards.description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

cards.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
cards.description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Galarian Slowpoke
cards.description: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

cards.name: Banette
cards.description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.description: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

cards.name: Hatenna
cards.description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

cards.name: Hattrem
cards.description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

cards.name: Hatterene
cards.description: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

cards.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
cards.description: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
cards.description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: Sharply attuned to others' wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.

cards.name: Galarian Yamask
cards.description: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

cards.name: Galarian Runerigus
cards.description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

cards.name: Kubfu
cards.description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

cards.name: Galarian Weezing
cards.description: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.

cards.name: Galarian Slowking
cards.description: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.
